source_caption_text:
Soulja Boy announced he will be running for president in 2028 😂🇺🇸🇺🇸

Who would vote for him??

Soulja Boy’s “Crank That” became much more than a hit song, it turned into a dance craze that helped change how rap could break online 🔥 Released in 2007 as the lead single from his debut album souljaboytellem.com, the track was self-produced by Soulja Boy and inspired fans everywhere to learn the dance, post their own versions and spread the song across the internet.

The numbers were huge: “Crank That” reached No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent seven weeks at the top. In 2008, it became the first song to reach 3 million digital downloads in the U.S. The track also earned a Grammy nomination for Best Rap Song, and its dance tutorial had already drawn more than 20 million YouTube views by early 2008.

The song’s success helped make Soulja Boy one of rap’s earliest internet-driven stars, with fans turning the dance into a viral challenge before social media challenges became a regular part of music promotion. Nearly two decades later, “Crank That” remains one of the defining rap hits of the 2000s and the “Superman” still gets people moving. Who remembers learning the dance?
